title: Position Thyself
story: There is a challenge program at `/challenge/run` that hands out your first real flag, but it is picky about two things: where you are standing in the filesystem (`pwd`), and how you invoke the program (its absolute path).
objective:
1. Change your current directory (`cd`) to `{MISSION01_DIR}`.
2. Run `/challenge/run` using its full absolute path.
3. Submit the `CYBERUS{...}` flag it prints with `quest submit`.
hints: Read the error message from `/challenge/run` carefully — it tells you which directory you must stand in.
Use `cd {MISSION01_DIR}` to move into the required directory, and `pwd` to confirm your location.
An absolute path starts with `/`. Once inside `{MISSION01_DIR}`, run `/challenge/run`.
